title: Who is Leopold Aschenbrenner, whose hedge fund melted down
excerpt: Leopold Aschenbrenner is the wunderkind and former OpenAI employee whose hedge fund is in chaos. Here's what you need to know about him.
content_html:
Meet the Gen Z AI whiz at the center of a hedge fund meltdown

By Alice Tecotzky

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Situational awareness is crucial to understanding what's happening with the hedge fund Situational Awareness — and the mid-20s wunderkind behind it.

Leopold Aschenbrenner is the man at the center of the high-profile hedge fund meltdown that's dominating headlines and X feeds, after his once $20-billion-firm was forced to sell most of its public equity holdings to Citadel on Wednesday. Heralded as an AI savant, Aschenbrenner worked at, and was quite publicly fired from, OpenAI before founding his now flailing firm.

Aschenbrenner has stood out for his intellectual chops since he was a teenager. A German native with coiffed blonde hair, he arrived at Columbia University when he was only 15 and quickly joined the debate team, he told the school's internal communications team. He co-founded an "effective altruism" group at Columbia, based on the same philosophical movement Sam Bankman-Fried championed. In 2021, Aschenbrenner graduated as the class valedictorian at the age of 19.

After graduating, Aschenbrenner joined OpenAI's superalignment team in San Francisco, which works on ensuring that superintelligence acts in accordance with human values. OpenAI fired him in 2024 after the company said he improperly shared internal information with external researchers. Aschenbrenner denied OpenAI's account on a podcast, saying that he did not disclose sensitive information and his firing was related to an internal memo about the company's security measures. He said OpenAI's human resources team issued a warning about the memo, and that he was fired shortly after.

In June of 2024, Aschenbrenner published a 165-page essay titled "Situational Awareness" that helped catapult him to prominence. He said AI will quickly transform the economy, as it demands gargantuan investments in computing power, semiconductors, memory, and energy infrastructure. He warned of "willful blindness," of war with China, of the potential perils of superintelligence.

"Before long, the world will wake up. But right now, there are perhaps a few hundred people, most of them in San Francisco and the AI labs, that have situational awareness. Through whatever peculiar forces of fate, I have found myself amongst them," Aschenbrenner wrote in the introduction to his essay. At the bottom, he thanked Ilya Sutskever and Jan Leike, who led his team at OpenAI, for "formative discussions," among others.

And then, without any prior investing experience, he founded the namesake AI-focused hedge fund that's spiraling. Situational Awareness has counted Jane Street, Stripe cofounders Patrick and John Collison, and former GitHub CEO Nat Friedman among its investors, and launched with less than $1 billion before rapidly scaling to reportedly $20 billion.

Aschenbrenner has built up a public image alongside his lean firm, which had only eight employees and four investment professionals as of a recent regulatory filing. He has more than 257,000 followers on X; a four-hour-long video podcast interview has racked up nearly 575,000 views on YouTube. Until recently, he was something of a Silicon Valley darling, with the podcaster Tim Ferriss calling him the "Nostradamus of AI."

Photos with Aschenbrenner are somewhat scarce, but he often looks like he stepped off of Columbia's campus, all quarter zips and turtlenecks and, in the four-hour podcast appearance, argyle socks. On his personal blog, under a photo of himself in a black cable-knit sweater, he says he aims to "secure the blessings of liberty for our posterity" and is interested in everything from First Amendment law to topology, but is focused on AI, at least "these days."

For now, Situational Awareness is holding onto its private portfolio of AI companies, including a stake in Anthropic. As Business Insider's Ali Barr wrote, Aschenbrenner may have the right long-term idea, but he might not survive in the market long enough to see it play out.

In typical internet fashion, Aschenbrenner's face is plastered all over social media as users drag his losses, from AI-generated videos of him and Citadel founder Ken Griffin to memes of him in a hospital bed. Yet it's not like everyone in the AI ecosystem is against Aschenbrenner — he's engaged to Avital Balwit, chief of staff for Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei.

态势感知对于了解对冲基金态势感知及其背后的 20 多岁神童的动态至关重要。

利奥波德·阿申布伦纳 (Leopold Aschenbrenner) 是备受瞩目的对冲基金崩溃的中心人物，这场崩溃占据了头条新闻和 X 新闻，周三，他曾经价值 200 亿美元的公司被迫将其持有的大部分公共股权出售给 Citadel。 阿申布伦纳 (Aschenbrenner) 被誉为人工智能专家，他曾在 OpenAI 工作过，后来被公开解雇，后来才创立了自己现在陷入困境的公司。

阿申布伦纳（Aschenbrenner）从青少年时期起就因其智力水平而脱颖而出。 他告诉学校的内部通讯团队，他是德国人，留着金色的头发，年仅 15 岁时就来到哥伦比亚大学，并很快加入了辩论队。 他在哥伦比亚大学与他人共同创立了一个“有效利他主义”团体，该团体的基础是萨姆·班克曼-弗里德所倡导的同一哲学运动。 2021 年，19 岁的阿申布伦纳以班级致告别辞的身份毕业。

毕业后，Aschenbrenner 加入了 OpenAI 位于旧金山的超级对齐团队，该团队致力于确保超级智能按照人类价值观行事。 OpenAI 于 2024 年解雇了他，此前该公司称他不恰当地与外部研究人员分享了内部信息。 Aschenbrenner 在播客上否认了 OpenAI 的说法，称他没有透露敏感信息，他的解雇与一份有关公司安全措施的内部备忘录有关。 他表示，OpenAI 的人力资源团队就该备忘录发出了警告，不久后他就被解雇了。

2024 年 6 月，阿申布伦纳发表了一篇题为“态势感知”的 165 页文章，帮助他一举成名。 他表示，人工智能将迅速改变经济，因为它需要在计算能力、半导体、内存和能源基础设施方面进行巨额投资。 他对“故意视而不见”、与中国的战争以及超级智能的潜在危险发出警告。

“不久之后，世界将会苏醒。 但现在，可能有几百人（其中大多数在旧金山和人工智能实验室）拥有态势感知能力。 无论命运的特殊力量如何，我发现自己就在他们之中，”阿申布伦纳在他的文章的序言中写道。 在最后，他感谢了 OpenAI 团队领导的 Ilya Sutskever 和 Jan Leike 进行的“形成性讨论”等。

然后，在没有任何投资经验的情况下，他创立了同名的专注于人工智能的对冲基金，该基金的业绩呈螺旋式上升。 Situational Awareness 的投资者包括 Jane Street、Stripe 联合创始人 Patrick 和 John Collison，以及 GitHub 前首席执行官 Nat Friedman，该公司成立时的投资额不到 10 亿美元，随后迅速扩大到据报道的 200 亿美元。

阿申布伦纳与他的精益公司一起建立了公众形象，根据最近的监管文件，该公司只有八名员工和四名投资专业人员。 他在 X 上拥有超过 257,000 名粉丝；长达四个小时的视频播客采访在 YouTube 上获得了近 575,000 次观看。 直到最近，他还是硅谷的宠儿，播客蒂姆·费里斯 (Tim Ferriss) 称他为“人工智能的诺查丹玛斯”。

与阿申布伦纳的照片有些稀少，但他经常看起来像是从哥伦比亚大学校园走出来的，穿着四分之一拉链和高领毛衣，在四个小时的播客节目中还穿着菱形图案的袜子。 在他的个人博客上，他在一张自己穿着黑色绞花针织毛衣的照片下表示，他的目标是“为我们的子孙后代争取自由的祝福”，并且对从第一修正案到拓扑学的一切都感兴趣，但至少“现在”专注于人工智能。

目前，Situational Awareness 仍持有其私人人工智能公司投资组合，其中包括 Anthropic 的股份。 正如《商业内幕》的阿里·巴尔（Ali Barr）所写，阿申布伦纳可能有正确的长期想法，但他可能无法在市场上生存足够长的时间来看到它发挥作用。

在典型的互联网时尚中，阿申布伦纳的脸贴满了社交媒体，用户拖着他的损失，从人工智能生成的他和 Citadel 创始人肯·格里芬的视频到他在医院病床上的表情包。 然而，并不是人工智能生态系统中的每个人都反对阿申布伦纳——他与 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 的幕僚长阿维塔尔·巴尔维特 (Avital Balwit) 订婚了。
